known.fact: Wants a quiet, productive Denmark and as little German violence as possible.
known.source: CHARACTERS.md v1 (Straarup, RAHS 2020; research notes; Knud Birk memoir; Randers Kommune info board)

known.fact: Reports to Berlin that the saboteurs are already caught and asks that no reprisals be taken against the population. The reason Langå was not Lidice.
known.source: CHARACTERS.md v1 (Straarup, RAHS 2020; research notes; Knud Birk memoir; Randers Kommune info board)

known.fact: Summoned to the Wolfsschanze 30 Dec 1943 with Pancke and von Hanneken; argues for faster courts; overruled by Hitler.
known.source: CHARACTERS.md v1 (Straarup, RAHS 2020; research notes; Knud Birk memoir; Randers Kommune info board)
